thread:
Managed Redis Hosting: The Fast Layer Beside Your Database

Quick thread 🧵
Redis is an in-memory data store you put in front of your database to make things fast.
Caching, sessions, rate limits, and job queues are its bread and butter.
It's an accelerator, not your source of truth.
Managed Redis hosting launches one right next to your app in the same account, locked to your app server's IP, kept running and backed up, connected with a single `REDIS_URL`.
